name: Mirage Abyss
summary: Mirage Abyss refers to the submerged trench and canyon formations situated in Thousand Needles where dry salt flats once stood. Now submerged deep beneath the waves, this drowned basin attracts salvagers seeking sunken treasures and herbalists searching the ocean floor.

sections.title: The Sunken Trench
sections.body: Beneath the surface of the Shimmering Deep lies the Mirage Abyss, a network of drowned gorges resting where Weazel's Crater once marked the parched desert. What was once an arid basin baked by the sun is now flooded with saltwater, blanketed in thick beds of stranglekelp and prowled by oceanic predators like giant whale sharks.

sections.title: Depths of Salvage
sections.body: The flooded canyon has become an opportunistic dive site for Southsea treasure hunters. Following the sinking of pirate vessels torn apart by deep-sea monsters, salvagers brave the crushing water to drag chests from the ocean floor, competing with local scavengers and dangerous aquatic life nestled in the murky depths.

faq.answer: The Mirage Abyss is a deep underwater canyon network situated in the Shimmering Deep of Thousand Needles. It occupies the sunken floor of the valley where dry landmarks like Weazel's Crater once stood.
Southsea treasure hunters explore the trench to recover sunken chests and valuable cargo lost when a colossal whale shark attacked and destroyed one of their vessels in the flooded basin.

faq.q: What flora grows in the abyss?
faq.answer: The submerged floor of the canyon provides fertile ground for rich thickets of stranglekelp, making it a prominent harvesting spot for underwater gatherers.

angles.text: The flooded gorges of the Mirage Abyss are laden with dense patches of stranglekelp, offering underwater harvesters ample gathering opportunities away from coastal shores.
